description: This file defines the ClaimDao class in a human resource management system, providing data access methods for managing claims, claim-related entities, and attachments. It includes CRUD operations, complex query building for filtering and pagination, and utility functions for claim processing.

classes.name: ClaimDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Claims, providing methods to manage claim events, expenses, types, attachments, and requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Persists a ClaimEvent entity in the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getClaimEventList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimEvent entities based on search filter parameters with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getClaimEventById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimEvent entity by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimEventIds
methods.description: Returns array of existing ClaimEvent IDs from a given list, filtering out deleted entries.

methods.name: deleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Marks specified ClaimEvent records as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveExpenseType
methods.description: Persists an ExpenseType entity.

methods.name: saveClaimRequest
methods.description: Saves a ClaimRequest entity.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Generates the next available ID for ClaimRequest entries.

methods.name: getExpenseTypeList
methods.description: Fetches a list of ExpenseType entities matching search criteria.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCount
methods.description: Returns count of ExpenseType entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getExpenseTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves an ExpenseType by ID if it exists and not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingExpenseTypeIds
methods.description: Returns existing ExpenseType IDs from a list, excluding deleted types.

methods.name: deleteExpenseTypes
methods.description: Marks specified ExpenseType records as deleted.

methods.name: saveClaimExpense
methods.description: Persists a ClaimExpense entity.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Retrieves ClaimExpense entities based on search filters with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseCount
methods.description: Returns count of ClaimExpense entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount for ClaimExpenses matching search filters.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimExpense by ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getClaimRequestExpense
methods.description: Fetches a specific ClaimExpense for a given request and expense ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimRequest by ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimExpenseIdsForRequestId
methods.description: Returns claim expense IDs filtered by request ID, excluding deleted.

methods.name: deleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Marks specified ClaimExpenses as deleted for a given request.

methods.name: saveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Persists a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: getNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Calculates the next attachment ID for a request.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimAttachments based on search filters.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ClaimAttachments matching search filters.

methods.name: getClaimAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ClaimAttachment based on request and attachment IDs.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a partial view of a claim attachment with specific fields.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimAttachment file by request and attachment IDs.

methods.name: getExistingClaimAttachmentIdsForRequestId
methods.description: Returns existing attachment IDs for a request filtering out deleted attachments.

methods.name: deleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Deletes specified attachments for a request.

methods.name: getClaimRequestList
methods.description: Fetches claim requests based on filters with pagination.

methods.name: getClaimRequestPaginator
methods.description: Builds a paginated query for claim requests, supporting multiple filters.

methods.name: getClaimRequestCount
methods.description: Returns the number of claim requests matching filters.

methods.name: isClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Checks whether a claim event is referenced by any claim request.

methods.name: isExpenseTypeUsed
methods.description: Checks whether an expense type is referenced by any claim expenses.
